provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Syrian Arab Republic. Transitional presidential republic.
rulers: Ahmad al-Shara'; former President Bashar al-ASAD was overthrown by Islamist rebels on 8 December 2024; Prime Minister Muhammad al-BASHIR (since 8 December 2024)
economy: low-income Middle Eastern economy; prior infrastructure and economy devastated by 11-year civil war; ongoing US sanctions; sporadic trans-migration during conflict; currently being supported by World Bank trust fund; ongoing hyperinflation GDP (PPP): $98.858 billion (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: the interim government authorities in Syria have established a Ministry of Defense and are attempting to unify the dozens of armed factions operating in Syria under a single, state-linked army; it has also established a Ministry of Interior to manage police and other security forces… (2025) Expenditure: 6.5% of GDP (2019 est.)
origin: 17 April 1946 (from League of Nations mandate under French administration)
